name: Mohammed bin Salman Al Saud
role: Crown Prince and Prime Minister of Saudi Arabia (crown prince since 2017, prime minister since 2022); de facto ruler
summary: Mohammed bin Salman leads Saudi Arabia as an authoritarian monarchy while driving economic diversification through Vision 2030, privatisation and the Public Investment Fund. He has cut the powers of the religious police and clerics, ended the driving ban and loosened guardianship, while keeping Islam as the constitutional basis and jailing critics. In foreign policy he is hostile to Iran, close to the US, open to Israeli normalisation tied to a Palestinian state, and says Saudi Arabia would seek nuclear weapons if Iran did.

Themes searched: economy, liberty, society, government, world, ecology, means and culture; most economy, technology and means statements have no stated position of his. He is shown only if the uncertainty rule passes. Positions on Israel moved: 2018 coexistence and a Palestinian state, 2022 potential ally, 2023 closer to normalisation, 2024 no relations without a Palestinian state; the Israel answers that rested on Wikipedia were nulled. The earlier answers that cited Wikipedia (s8) and an NPR summary (s9) were revised or nulled; they remain listed only as sources of leads.
